description: This file implements a Microsoft Visual FoxPro database driver class and related record set class as part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer for PHP. It includes driver setup, connection handling, and data type mapping specific to Visual FoxPro.

classes.name: ADODB_vfp
classes.description: Driver class for Microsoft Visual FoxPro, extending the ODBC driver with VFP-specific implementations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_vfp
classes.description: RecordSet class for handling query results in the Visual FoxPro driver, extending the generic ODBC record set.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a transaction; always returns false indicating no support for transactions.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Quotes and sanitizes a string for safe database input.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL statement with a limit on number of rows, adjusting the 'top' support based on the presence of 'ORDER BY'.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps database field types to internal type codes, with special handling for BLOBs and date/time types.
